note: Additional research, not an imported production POI dataset. Public visibility and technical retrieval are distinct from permission to reuse. No purchases, signups, contacts, commits or pushes performed.

poi_apis.scope: Remaining POI API options for an Astana walking recommender hackathon; already-covered primary datasets deliberately omitted.

candidates.next_check: Only if an existing key is available, test central Astana discover and category browse for known landmarks and compare optional hours/contact completeness; obey returned cache headers.

candidates.access: Registered/signed-in account and API key; evaluation usage is advertised. No account or key created; current exact allowance not assumed.
candidates.storage_export: Current official terms 11.4 generally prohibit storage except client cache permitted by returned control headers, only through max-age; no shared-result scaling. Section 11.6.1 prohibits compiling secondary/derived databases from licensed results. Section 3 separately preserves rights in data actually identified as ODbL; do not assume all Orbis POIs are ODbL or unrestricted merely because Orbis contains open data. Dataset redistribution and AI retention clauses also apply.

local_catalogues.scope: Astana tourism, culture, retail, cafe and event directories; source inspection only, no bulk crawl, contact, account access, purchase, or Git changes.
local_catalogues.method: Primary website pages inspected using web search/open plus a small number of direct ordinary HTTP GETs. Firecrawl CLI absent. Raw sample pages are in round4/raw_local; no endpoint fuzzing or access-control bypass.
local_catalogues.reuse_status: Technical accessibility is recorded separately from rights. No open-data licence, public bulk-download permission, or documented generally available POI API was established for these sources. Check terms and obtain appropriate reuse rights before systematic ingestion; public HTML and embedded JSON alone are not permission.

sources.name: Astana CityPass
observed_data: Catalogue says more than 34 attractions; first page exposes 12 cards and three-page controls.
Names, categories, addresses, map links, pass eligibility; detail descriptions, photos, hours, phone, external site where supplied.
Railways museum detail supplies address, Tue-Sun hours, phone and railwaymuseum.kz.
sources.access: HTML/Next.js server-rendered cards and details; page-source JSON-LD observed but sampled JSON-LD was Organization/WebSite metadata, not a verified complete attraction feed. No documented open API located.
sources.extraction: Follow catalogue pagination and canonical detail links; deduplicate excursions vs actual venues. Use attraction-specific sections, retain field provenance.
constraints: Pass eligibility and Available today are commercial-product state, not a general guarantee that a venue is open.
Pass benefit must not be represented as unconditional free admission.
Some entries such as ALZHIR are outside municipal Astana: apply geometry/city filtering.
Hours and prices should be timestamped and refreshed; illustrative refresh weekly is a product choice.
sources.verification: Live HTML and individual detail verified.

sources.name: MEGA Restaurants — Silk Way
observed_data: Restaurant names/logos, narrative cuisine descriptions, Silk Way floor, individual schedules, menu links.
Observed examples include Cafeteria with weekday-specific schedule, Starbucks, Rumi, JINAU, Coffee BOOM, Del Papa and Korean House.
sources.access: Ordinary HTML; one GET succeeded. Wagtail asset paths observed; no documented public restaurant API established.
sources.extraction: Keep sm=2 mall selection; parse each restaurant block and its menu href; menu links can be PDF or other pages.
constraints: Mall-specific coverage; cannot infer all Astana branches or citywide coverage.
Some names appear through logos/alt text and some hours differ from mall hours.
Menu availability and listed prices may change independently.
sources.verification: Live rendered HTML and raw single page verified.

related_blocked_or_partial.result: Ordinary GET returned a short Nuxt loading shell, not a verified tenant directory. Web tool could not access it.

sources.name: Khan Shatyr tenant and floor-map directory
observed_data: Shopping categories with counts, cafes/restaurants, foodcourt, entertainment and address.
Cafe category links include Starbucks, Ottoman cafe, Cafe latte, Pizza City, CUPS coffee, Expresso and Le Pain.
Tenant links expose floor and numeric tenant identity, e.g. /map/1/show/342 for Starbucks; source includes generated SVG/D3 text and data-id values.
sources.access: Categories are ordinary HTML. Floor map is script-generated and text-only scrapers may miss tenant content. No documented public API verified.
sources.extraction: Start with category link lists; preserve floor and tenant ID from linked map URL. Render map or parse only verified embedded labels if indoor placement matters.
constraints: Do not sum category counts as unique tenant count; brands can occur across categories and multiple floors.
Two CUPS entries appear in the same cafe category; preserve separate units until confirmed duplicates.
An SVG indoor position is not a geographic latitude/longitude.
Tenant detail popups may need rendering; initial text scraper did not expose full Starbucks popup details.
sources.verification: Live category HTML and single floor-map raw HTML verified.

sources.name: Green Mall tenant directory
observed_data: All-brands category shows 69 entries, filter categories and individual opening hours.
Includes coffee, restaurants, groceries, pharmacy, fitness, retail and services; mall address is Syganak 17B.
Marwin tenant detail provides description, individual schedule, indoor-location text, phone, external website and social link.
sources.access: Readable ordinary HTML with linked tenant detail pages; no documented open API verified.
sources.extraction: Parse brand cards and canonical details; use mall as parent POI.
constraints: The directory includes a vacant-leasing entry; it is not an active business POI.
Published category counts need not match unique active tenants.
Indoor location and mall coordinate should be stored separately.
Copyright footer year does not establish update freshness.
sources.verification: Official directory and sample detail verified.

sources.name: Astana Centralized Library System
observed_data: Branch names and street addresses, branch-specific opening hours, weekly closed days, sanitary closure rules, phone and map links.
Central M. Auezov library gives Abilay Khan 4/1, a later evening schedule and separate Saturday hours; child and accessibility-specialist branches are distinguished.
Older about page says 22 branches; a current city-government article says 25.
sources.access: Contacts are static readable HTML. No documented POI API or downloadable branch feed verified.
sources.extraction: Parse repeated branch sections; separately model weekly schedule and monthly sanitary-day exception; map shortlinks are location references, not a licence to ingest a third-party map database.
constraints: Do not use an old about-page total to limit current branch extraction.
Branch numbers can overlap for general and children libraries; key by system+type+branch number/address.
Book/electronic catalogues are a separate content domain and do not constitute a POI inventory.
sources.verification: Live contacts HTML and conflicting official count evidence verified.

sources.name: MARWIN / Meloman official store locator
sources.type: Official chain locator with embedded structured data
observed_data: Single HTML page embeds Magento JSON with path ["*"]["Magento_Ui/js/core/app"].components.shops.config.stores.astana.shops.
Astana group contains 28 entries in this sample: 8 MARWIN/Meloman stores and 20 Europharma partner pickup points.
Fields: name, code, address, schedule, image_url, location.lat, location.lng, phoneNumbers.
sources.access: One ordinary HTTP GET succeeded; text web reader intermittently timed out. Structured config is inside script type=text/x-magento-init; a separate API is unnecessary for this sampled page. This is embedded application data, not a documented open-data API.
sources.extraction: Parse JSON strictly and select stores.astana.shops; filter names or explicit business classification for genuine bookstore/toy branches. Preserve code as source ID, not a universal ID.
constraints: Pickup locations are not MARWIN retail stores; do not turn all 28 into bookstores.
Coordinates should be validated against the city boundary and address.
Record count is a point-in-time sample, not a guaranteed ongoing total.
Store images and descriptive copy have separate rights from factual attributes.
sources.verification: Raw HTML config parsed successfully; Astana group and fields verified without crawling store details.

sources.name: Sxodim Astana places and events
sources.type: Local editorial venue catalogue and event discovery
observed_data: Coffee category has canonical /place/ detail links and page= pagination; first page links to Rafe, Tary, Jasyl, Nektar and others.
Sample Rafe detail has address, cuisine, daily hours, phone, average check, menu link, multiple branches, descriptive traits, and publication date 2022-01-30.
Current afisha pages expose event names, venue/address, dates/times, price-from and category.
sources.access: Ordinary HTML with linked place details and pagination; JS load-more/calendar in some views. No documented generally available API or data feed verified.
sources.extraction: Place listings provide discovery; parse explicit place blocks rather than entire page text. Event source needs independent event records with starts/ends and venue linkage.
constraints: Historical place publication dates can make cuisine/hours/prices stale; source date and checked time must both be retained.
Page footer contains long irrelevant old event terms; do not feed entire HTML text into RAG.
Category JSON-LD may describe promoted events rather than the place directory; validate schema and scope.
A multi-branch place page must be split into separate physical POIs.
Keep subjective editorial descriptions separate from verified amenities.
sources.verification: Live place detail + event HTML, single raw catalogue and coffee category verified.

sources.name: Ticketon venue pages
sources.type: Ticket operator venue catalogue and attached events
observed_data: Indexed official Congress Center page shows current event list, age labels, dates/times, ticket-price-from, street address, phone, venue description and parking/access notes.
Indexed official Astana Arena detail supplies address, telephone and parking/entrance information.
sources.access: Search index exposes official HTML, but direct requests using web open returned 403/failed for sampled main and mobile pages. No documented publicly reusable API established.
sources.extraction: Use approved feed/partner access if available; otherwise handle accessible pages conservatively and do not bypass the observed 403. Treat event list as volatile.
constraints: Not currently reliable as an unattended crawl backbone based on observed blocking.
Indexed content can lag; verify event dates and cancellations before user-facing recommendations.
Prices distinguish normal price and cashback/discount price; do not collapse these.
Venue-level facts and event-level occurrences are different records.
sources.verification: Primary search results inspected; direct page reading blocked, explicitly partial.

assessed_lower_priority_or_unusable.name: Kazakhstan Travel
assessed_lower_priority_or_unusable.status: Readable official regional narrative, but Tourist attractions and Tourist routes sections remained Loading in inspected output; regional news/events empty. Useful multilingual historical/architectural context, low incremental POI coverage against VisitAstana, not a verified complete feed or current-hours source.

assessed_lower_priority_or_unusable.name: iTicket Kazakhstan
assessed_lower_priority_or_unusable.status: The .kz homepage redirected to corporate iticket.global with event-production marketing; indexed /maintenance page also exists. No functioning Astana venue/event catalogue verified; do not list it as an available ingestion source.

assessed_lower_priority_or_unusable.name: Astana Ballet official contact page
assessed_lower_priority_or_unusable.status: Useful direct single-venue authority. Explicitly gives current Uly Dala 43 and former Uly Dala 9, plus box-office phone. Good for address-alias corrections; no bulk catalogue/API verified.

recommended_order: MARWIN embedded locator for small structured seed
Astana-library official contacts for underrepresented civic/culture POIs
MEGA Restaurants + Khan Shatyr + Green Mall for indoor tenant coverage
Sxodim places for long-tail discovery and subjective tags with staleness handling
Sxodim events as separate expiring layer
Ticketon only when access/reuse are settled; direct sample currently blocked
local_catalogues.diminishing_returns: Further individual brand/mall/venue sites repeat this pattern and add narrow coverage rather than another citywide database. These should be selected to fill measured gaps after core OSM/Overture/FSQ + tourism sources are deduplicated.

supplemental_context.scope: Astana supplementary/contextual data only; six categories, seven source records; no accounts, purchases, contacts or Git changes
supplemental_context.research_method: Official primary documentation and read-only HTTP probes. Firecrawl unavailable locally; used web research and standard HTTP requests.

ORS/GraphHopper after key and hosted terms review
CTS official GTFS only after feed and license discovery

sources.name: accessibility.cloud / Wheelmap
sources.role: POI accessibility enrichment; not a complete new inventory
sources.access: App authentication token required as appToken; no account or token created. Recommended CDN base: https://accessibility-cloud-v2.freetls.fastly.net .
sources.coverage: API capability verified from official documentation; Astana record count and completeness NOT verified because no app token was used.
sources.storage_license: Licenses vary by source. Read returned licenses and retain source/license provenance before storing or redistributing; do not label all data CC BY or ODbL. Pagination max 1000/page; CDN cache up to 5 minutes.
sources.recommendation: Optional enrichment after local coverage audit. Missing information means unknown accessibility, never inaccessible.

sources.name: Open-Meteo Forecast API
sources.access: No key or signup for non-commercial free service. Free hosted service: <10000/day, 5000/hour, 600/min; commercial use requires paid plan even though underlying data license permits commercial reuse.
sources.coverage: Live Astana coordinate request HTTP 200 on 2026-10-18, timezone Asia/Almaty, 24 hourly points; provider grid coordinate differs from requested coordinate.
sources.storage_license: API data CC BY 4.0; attribution required. Data can be stored and redistributed under that license; distinguish data license from hosted API commercial-use conditions.
sources.recommendation: Best immediately usable weather source for hackathon; cache city forecasts and use to adjust walk duration/indoor recommendations.

sources.name: Kazhydromet WIS2 observations
sources.role: Official local observation context; not forecast, warning feed, or POIs
sources.access: Public OGC API JSON endpoints returned HTTP 200 without key.
sources.coverage: Live Astana bbox station metadata returned 2 operational stations: Bayterek (35180) and Nur-Sultan (35188). Actual SYNOP observation probe returned station 35188 reports at 2026-10-18T15:00:00Z.
sources.storage_license: SYNOP discovery metadata says wmo:dataPolicy=core. WMO official training defines core as free, unrestricted, no charge and no conditions on use. Preserve provider, timestamps and station IDs.
sources.recommendation: Strong official observation supplement; normalize one-feature-per-variable observations. Do not infer official alerts or future forecast from this endpoint.

sources.name: Pedestrian routing services
sources.role: Route geometry, realistic distance/time, matrices/isochrones; not an independent POI inventory

providers.name: Valhalla
providers.access: Self-host, or fair-use FOSSGIS public demo; demo has no key. For published end-user apps the README asks for Github notice and identifying X-Client-Id. No contact made.
providers.coverage: LIVE Astana route using costing=pedestrian succeeded: 1.552 km, 1115.686 seconds (~18.6 min) for supplied coordinates. One route confirms response, not full network quality.
providers.storage_license: Self-host supports controlled persistence; comply with upstream data licenses. OSM attribution required; additional attribution if elevation data used. Public demo is fair-use, not unlimited production infrastructure.

providers.name: openrouteservice
providers.access: Hosted API key required; free token is available after signup. No key obtained. Walking, hiking, wheelchair directions plus matrices/isochrones.
providers.coverage: Official docs claim global directions coverage; Astana routing not live-tested without a key.
providers.storage_license: OSM/ORS attribution applies; current hosted Terms page redirects to HeiGIT app and was not readable by text fetch. Do not assume indefinite commercial route database rights. Self-host is an alternative.

providers.name: GraphHopper
providers.access: Hosted Directions API requires account and API key; self-hosted engine alternative.
providers.coverage: Routing docs verified; Astana route not live-tested without key.
providers.storage_license: Terms explicitly allow temporary client-side caching and prohibit scraping/mass download unless package states otherwise; API redistribution needs custom agreement. Current attribution page requires OSM; GraphHopper attribution page says their attribution is appreciated (older terms differ).

sources.warning: OSRM transport mode is determined by graph preprocessing Lua profile; changing URL profile text alone does not select a pedestrian graph. Do not use driving demo results as walking times.
sources.recommendation: Use an actual pedestrian profile. Valhalla live check is promising; for production choose self-host or documented hosted plan and visually audit bridges, crossings, entrances and closures.

sources.name: Astana City Transportation Systems (CTS)
sources.role: Transit access/return-trip context and service-change references; not sightseeing inventory
sources.access: Official public website available. No downloadable official GTFS ZIP, GTFS-RT feed, developer API, key policy or open data license found during this research.
sources.coverage: Operator and Astana relevance verified. Current official routes page says information temporarily unavailable. Official GTFS availability NOT verified; do not represent any guessed URL as a feed.
sources.storage_license: No dataset license verified; web accessibility is not permission to mirror an operational transit dataset.
sources.recommendation: Keep as an official reference lead; exclude transit feed integration from ready-to-import sources until public feed URL and license are verified.

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons
sources.role: Licensed visual enrichment, photo-backed landmarks; not complete POI inventory
sources.access: Public MediaWiki read API, no key for tested requests. Geosearch file namespace=6 plus imageinfo url|extmetadata.
sources.coverage: Live 10 km search around 51.1282,71.4304 returned 10 file records (requested limit=10, NOT total coverage). Sample Astana SAM 0086 by Alex J. Butler is CC BY 2.0.
sources.storage_license: Per-file license. Retain author, source file description URL, license URL, attribution requirements and modification note. CC BY-SA derivatives require compatible sharing; public-domain status still needs provenance.
sources.recommendation: Best reusable photo source; match to POI by Wikidata Commons/P18 linkage or manual curation. Nearby geotag does not prove the photo depicts a specific POI.

sources.name: Open-Meteo / CAMS Air Quality API
sources.role: City-scale outdoor context; not street-level pollution, safety certification or POI inventory
sources.access: Same free non-commercial hosted API terms as Open-Meteo weather; no key for tested JSON request.
sources.coverage: Live Astana JSON HTTP 200 with 24 hourly points. Global CAMS composition model is ~45 km spatial and 3-hourly native temporal resolution; API hourly outputs do not make it street-level. Pollen fields are Europe-only.
sources.storage_license: CC BY 4.0 data; docs request attribution to Open-Meteo and CAMS data provider. Keep model/time metadata.
sources.recommendation: Optional after core route/POI quality; helps choose outdoor duration, but cannot rank adjacent streets for cleaner air.
